reasoning: On the season so far the Clippers are the stronger team; with home court the Clippers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hornets (look-ahead, confidence).
Bottom line: the Clippers win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 189 and 238 total points.

analyst.text: The Clippers come in buoyed by a late rally to beat Oklahoma City, though Brandon Ingram still has not debuted and Tyronn Lue's comments on Bradley Beal's repeated setbacks cast doubt on his return. Charlotte get Brandon Miller back from a hip strain but have lost seven of eight, open a four-game road trip here and have lost 16 straight to the Clippers. The mood leans towards the Clippers.
